justification: data-watch sends failing checks to Telegram and also runs 30 minutes after rules go live; the checks are unchanged.

pre_impl.existing_data: data-watch failed 2026-10-22, 23 and 24 and only opened a GitHub issue; dcp-commit takes approved rules live at 09:00 UTC (railway.dcp-commit.toml).
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: The issue was assumed to be read; the user's channel is Telegram. Nightly-only checks would leave a bad commit unseen for about 11 hours.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Reuses the issue step's outcome list and names; one new step and one new schedule.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: a check the workflow marks as failure is missing from the Telegram text, or Telegram's own reply is not ok while the run stays green
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Not self-referential: the tests read the real data-watch.yml (an independent file) for the name list and outcome string, and Telegram's own reply decides delivered. Telegram's real API answered ok on 2026-10-23 with these secrets.

functions.name: failing
functions.input: comma-separated step outcomes in the issue step's order
functions.output: names of the checks that failed
functions.if_none: a missing outcome counts as failing

functions.name: main
functions.input: FAILED, RUN_URL and Telegram secrets from the environment
functions.output: exit 0 when clean or delivered, 1 when red and not delivered
functions.if_none: missing Telegram secrets with a red check exit 1

break_it.scenario: Telegram token is stale, as GitHub's was on 2026-10-23
break_it.what_happens: failing checks would go unreported again
break_it.how: red not delivered exits 1, so the run itself goes red

break_it.scenario: Someone adds a check to the issue step but not to this script
break_it.what_happens: its failure would be sent under the wrong name
break_it.how: a test requires both name lists and outcome strings to be equal

break_it.scenario: An approved commit at 09:00 UTC serves wrong rules

post_merge.secrets: TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN and TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID already exist as GitHub secrets (refreshed 2026-10-23).
post_merge.manual_verify: Run data-watch by hand; with a failing check a Telegram message arrives.
